steps.note: Create the live event required by the setup.
Give the event a searchable title.
Use an RFQ stage because the case is about submitting a quote sheet.
Apply the first available pricing template.
Add one product so the quote sheet has a line to complete.
Complete the buyer-side pricing sheet before publishing.
Invite the QA vendor required for the vendor portal flow.
Publish the event so it appears as live to the vendor.
Verify the event reached a real published project page.
Continue in the invited vendor's supplier portal.
Open the live event card on the vendor dashboard and land on Event Overview.
Perform the vendor's participation action from the overview.
Open the quote sheet after participating.
Fill the mandatory quote fields and submit the vendor response.
Verify the vendor portal shows the submitted response state.
